answers: Marketing thinks that if they don't have a bit of titanium between the two fronts, users may get problems with the LCD screen, like some dust in it — because people have always all kinds of filth between the mobile, when people exchange all the fronts, the control is open. And the group decides to have a bit of titanium in between, and with the curved edge.

full.prediction: The group discusses the problem of dust in the control by considering the potential issues that arise when exchanging fronts, such as dust getting into the device. As a result, they decide to make only a portion of the remote titanium, specifically the lower part, to add some weight and reduce the likelihood of dust entering the device.
